label: Diagram 13.1
caption: Diagram 13.1 Principles of space separation
description:
Diagram 13.1, captioned "Principles of space separation" on a green band at the bottom, is an isometric line drawing. Top left reads "See para 13.4". Three vertical wall panels are set in a row, each at a different distance from a dashed line that runs diagonally across the foreground. Two green double-headed arrows link the middle and right panels to this line.

The left panel, marked with a small window near its top, is headed "Wall on or very close to the relevant boundary: very limited amounts of unprotected area"; a leader from its right edge reads "Fire resisting from both sides".

The middle panel, with a central square window, is headed "Wall not on, or not very close to, but not sufficiently far from relevant boundary that it can be a wholly unprotected area"; its right-edge leader reads "Fire resisting from inside: reduced insulation criterion".

The right panel, showing three vertical window frames, is headed "Wall sufficiently distant from relevant boundary to be a 100% unprotected area"; its leader reads "No provision for fire resistance".

A legend at lower left defines the dashed line as "Relevant boundary" and the green arrow as "Amount of unprotected area dependent on distance from relevant boundary".
